data.body: Implementer subagent finished (held-out: it never saw my validation). Investigation resolved the open question as (b): acli_cmd is purely an argv prefix for the ACLI binary (acli_subprocess.py:374-375, _DEFAULT_ACLI_CMD at :30), carries no target/credential, and every production construction site passes nothing; update_priority spawns no subprocess at all. So NO cross-target write exists -- signature hygiene, not a correctness bug. Param removed from update_priority + caller. String-grep for the name as a string: zero hits. Awaiting my held-out validation before commit.
